What is Saboot and how does it work?

Long image

A

Answer

Saboot is a front-end-only simulation of a disaster crop-loss evidence layer. Rules start an evidence clock at the storm, the farmer's phone seals photos so tampering shows, and an officer console ranks plots for review. It never decides a claim.

  1. Three pure rules (rain, radar, river) decide when an event starts, and the earliest signal wins.1
  2. Each farmer's photos are sealed in a SHA-256 hash chain on the phone, and a signed code can carry the seal to a laptop.2
  3. The officer sees a tier and a priority with uncertainty, never a claim decision.3
  4. All data is synthetic from one seeded replay, and the site works offline after one visit.4

Applies tosaboot-clean at ff4d148static app, synthetic dataread from source, not run

1

What does Saboot do, and what does it refuse to do?

Problem
After a flood, field evidence fades as water recedes, while assessment needs officers to reach every field.
Idea
Watch simulated rain, river and radar signals, start a clock at the event, and guide sealed photo capture in the farmer's language.
Output
A ranked worklist and a draft assessment list that say why each plot sits where it does.
Stack
Vite, Preact, Preact signals and TypeScript, with no backend and no UI kit.
Context
Built for the Code Yudh Hackathon, AgriTech and Agri-FinTech track.

Saboot assembles evidence and never decides

Deterministic rules own detection and timing. AI is limited to perception and language. Nothing files a claim, places a real call or reaches a government system. The decision happens outside Saboot.

  1. Seeded scenario ↗

    Built by scripts/gen-scenario.ts with a seeded random generator, so every run writes the same replay file.

  2. Engine and model ↗

    Runs a seven-day replay clock and rebuilds the model when the rail or radar cadence changes.

  3. Rules A B C ↗

    Plain functions of numbers, shared by the app and the real-data validation harness.

  4. Phone log ↗

    One hash-chained log per farmer. Photos stay here, and only fingerprints travel.

  5. Officer console ↗

    Scores and ranks every plot, and imports signed packets from a phone by QR, paste or link.

  6. Audit ledger ↗

    Every cohort event in one append-only chain, with a verify button and a tamper test.

RuleFires whenEvent clock starts atVersion
A: rain on low land24-hour rain at the nearest gauge reaches the heavy-rain line on a low-lying plotFirst time that gauge crossed the lower rain line1
B: radar changeRadar water above the crop's usual water reaches the flood shareLast clear radar pass2

When unsure, the farmer gets less time

Detection is the earliest rule to fire. The clock starts at the earliest qualifying signal before it, never later.5 Paddy in the standing-water season is expected to look wet, so only water above that level counts. This is an unvalidated design decision. Confidence is high when two rules fired, low when only radar fired on a wet crop, and medium otherwise.

  • IndexedDB idb
  • Simulated server server

  • app → idb · Photo blob and shot link
  • app → idb · Outbox entry if weak or offline
  • farmer → app · Seal packet
  • app → idb · Seal link with packet hash
  • app → idb · Read outbox
  • app → server · Fingerprints first, bodies later
  • server → app · Receipt time stamped
  • app → idb · Sync link appended

How the chain works

Each link is SHA-256 of the previous hash plus the canonical JSON of its body, and the first link follows 64 zeros.2 Editing any stored record breaks that link and every later one, which the ledger tamper test shows on screen.6 On a weak network each fingerprint goes alone about every 1.2 seconds, and it fixes the server receipt time before any photo body moves.7 A gap of more than 2 hours between phone time and server time is flagged for review.

5

How are plots scored and ranked?

CaseWhat changes
Plot the river can reachSum stays 1A river factor takes 0.10, and the other five weights are scaled to 0.90
Paddy in standing-water seasonUnvalidatedRadar keeps 0.4 of its weight, then all weights are renormalised, and its uncertainty widens
Tier ruleSupported needs the whole uncertainty band at or above 0.60, and insufficient needs it all below 0.45
HailA low-confidence prompt, capped at partial, and a plot that never replies is unconfirmed, not missed

Weights are scenario parameters, not fitted to any claims data.8 The priority formula is pinned by a unit test against the original build.9

6

How does evidence travel from phone to laptop?

  1. Seal on the phone

    After sealing, the Proof screen offers Share as a QR code. The packet becomes one signed code.

  2. Carry the code

    It is a QR code, a copyable code, or a link whose #k= fragment never reaches a server.

  3. Import on the laptop

    The officer console scans with the webcam, accepts a pasted code, or opens the link.

  4. Recompute and verify

    The console rebuilds the chain from the shot records and checks the ECDSA P-256 signature.

  5. Show the result

    A pass reads: integrity verified, not altered since sealing. The plot appears as Imported (live).

Header
Version, plot number, event and seal times, phone clock, location rounded to about 100 m, shot count: 19 bytes
Per photo
Kind, replay time and SHA-256: 35 bytes each, 3 photos = 105 bytes
Trailer
Chain head 32 bytes, compressed public key 33 bytes, signature 64 bytes
Size
19 + 105 + 129 = 253 bytes, about 338 base64url characters

What a verified packet does and does not prove

It proves the packet was not altered after sealing. It does not prove who sealed it, that the photos are true, or that the phone clock was right.10 The helper name and consent text travel in an unsigned context block in format version 1. A standalone script, scripts/verify-packet.mjs, checks the same format with no Saboot imports, and ten test vectors must give the same answer in both verifiers.

How do the two rails differ?

AspectRelief (primary, default)Crop insurance (second)
SupportsA state or district revenue assessment of flood lossesThe 72-hour intimation of a localized calamity
The windowNot a deadlineAdvice of 48 hours, "capture soon", never redHard deadlineA rule of 72 hours, red once passed
Who acknowledgesThe officerThe insurer
State namedNoneA fictional district in Haryana, marked to confirm Haryana runs the scheme
AmountsNone anywhereNone anywhere

The rail changes words, windows and actors. It does not change detection, event times, capture, sealing, tiers or priority, and a test pins identical detections on both.11

How is it built, tested and shipped?

  1. Generate the scenario

    Run npm run gen to write the replay, a TypeScript summary and the docs facts.

  2. Build and postbuild

    Vite builds, then the postbuild step prerenders the shell, adds social tags, hashes inline scripts into the CSP and writes the service worker.12

  3. Run every gate

    Run npm run verify: types, lint, unit tests, i18n parity, contrast, size budgets, Playwright with axe, and Lighthouse.

  4. Deploy by hand

    Run npm run deploy. It refuses while a gate fails or any real-world claim marker remains.
